note: Room and scene configuration foundation for Kitten Nest. This file is not a full roomEngine runtime yet. It keeps scene identity, active ports, protected current runtime facts, and directorRef hooks. Long director notes live in docs/DIRECTOR_GUIDE.md.

currentRuntime.stableWorkflow: Alex update package -> /write -> generate drafts -> publish all -> /cloud. The powder notebook currently appears as a physical home object and opens a home-scoped archive-first notebook panel. Setup/local upload remains manually available. CoffeeCorner lap-close is a scene variant with its own upper-left bubble and chest hotspot, not a new room and not the normal rotating coffeeCorner bubble.

identityPolicy.sceneRule: Scenes belong in room-config; interactive objects and hotspots belong in object-registry.
identityPolicy.variantRule: Scene variants belong under their parent scene in room-config. Their hotspots and text ports still need object-registry identity cards.
identityPolicy.ownershipRule: Every active selector has one primary owner. exclusive:true means no casual selector reuse.
identityPolicy.versionRule: canonicalCurrent means current official truth, not permanent immutability. Current objects may change later through mutableWithVersion.
identityPolicy.coordinateRule: Coordinates should be locked to base-image coordinates, not device-specific offsets.
identityPolicy.roomGateRule: Hotspots and overlays must be gated to their active room element so home and coffeeCorner controls do not leak into each other.
identityPolicy.panelScopeRule: A panel injected globally into /cloud is not automatically shared. Scope a panel by its actual scene ownership and actual entry points.
identityPolicy.directorRule: Use directorRef and directorTags here; put long director notes in docs/DIRECTOR_GUIDE.md.

scenes.label: 主页 / home
scenes.notes: Current visual entry/background logic. Not a full text room yet. Home has the current physical powder notebook hotspot. Its archive-first panel is home.hubbyNotePanel. Home-only hotspots and panels must not be treated as coffeeCorner or shared unless a later explicit decision changes that.

scenes.label: 咖啡角

textPorts.notes: This upper-left bubble belongs only to the lap-close scene variant and must not inherit the normal coffeeCorner rotating bubble queue.

sceneVariants.label: 坐腿近景 / lap-close
sceneVariants.notes: A coffeeCorner scene variant entered by tapping Alex's lap/leg area. It is intimate, sweet, and close, but still belongs to coffeeCorner. It uses its own upper-left lapClose bubble, has a lap-only chest hotspot, and hides the normal coffeeCorner bubble while active.

scenes.notes: Current real front-stage room. CoffeeCorner currently has no physical powder notebook object and no coffeeCorner notebook panel. Object and hotspot details are in data/object-registry.v1.json. CoffeeCorner hotspots must be gated to gameRoom.active. The lap-close variant is a child scene variant, not a separate room.

isolatedWorlds.label: Nestward / 窝里窝外

architectureNotes.nextRefactorGoal: Make hotspot and overlay placement configuration-driven inside existing front-end assets without adding new API wrappers. Keep notebook data/control logic separate from future notebook art/layout.
architectureNotes.principle: Static assets, front-end controllers, and JSON config should carry future world expansion. Do not add more runtime API functions for rooms, image proxies, or hotspot wrappers.
